title: MCP Schema-Defined Tool
description: A saved-query tool exposed on the MCP server, defined per collection.

name.description: Tool name in snake_case. Globally unique across all core, extension, and schema tools (including any mcp.toolPrefix).

description.description: Human-readable description AI agents read. Auto-generated parameter block is appended at registration time.

params.description: Typed caller parameters. Keys are snake_case param names; values declare type and validation. Omit for fixed-filter tools.

filters.description: Field-name to value+operator map. Filter values may reference {{params.X}} placeholders.

limit.description: Max results returned (default 20). Schema validation enforces the upper bound of 50.

offset.description: Skip the first N matching results — for paginated tools where 'limit' results aren't enough.

include.description: REST-style include filter string — escape hatch for shapes the structured `filters` block can't express.

exclude.description: REST-style exclude filter string — escape hatch for shapes the structured `filters` block can't express.

format.description: Output format for rich-text fields: markdown (default), html, or plain text.
